card.name: Syllables inside romanized Chinese names
card.fires_on: Letters or syllables inside pinyin or other romanized transliterations of Chinese terms, mostly accented vowels like ī, é, ā. It appears in parenthetical pronunciation or romanization glosses.

modes.label: Pinyin gloss
modes.description: Syllables of a pinyin spelling given after Chinese characters in a definition.

modes.label: Pronunciation respelling
modes.description: Accented letters inside a phonetic respelling of a foreign name.

card.writes: Promotes Chinese-character tokens and suppresses unrelated English words, suggesting it pushes toward continuing in Chinese text.
card.plain: It lights up inside the romanized spelling of Chinese words, such as pinyin given in brackets.
